INSTANCE MODEL (inferred: the source names the outputs, not their container): the outputs of a §5 verification algorithm as one JSON object, {status, document, mediaType}. The definitions are inline.verbatim.txt I-07 (outputs) and I-08 to I-10 (inputs). The §5 steps are normative and carry no BCP 14 keyword, so most constraints cite locators; w3c-vc-jose-cose#R-0080 is the requirement that binds the output. LEVELS. The root and every anchor not ending in -should state MUST and MUST NOT rules: a failure is non-conformance. A rule marked imported is a MUST of another document, named with the clause of this source that makes it bind. Anchors ending in -should add the SHOULD, SHOULD NOT, RECOMMENDED and NOT RECOMMENDED statements and include the MUST level by reference: a failure there is a deviation from a recommendation, to be reported as a warning, never as non-conformance. A constraint marked inferred is a reading this library made, not a statement of the source. ANCHORS: #jose (§5.1), #sd-jwt (§5.2), #cose (§5.3).
title: Outputs of the verification algorithms of §5 (DERIVED)

status.$comment: §5 outputs: “status: a boolean indicating the result of verification, true for success and false for failure.” (§5)

document.$comment: §5 outputs: “document: a document conforming to the [VC-DATA-MODEL-2.0]” (§5)

mediaType.$comment: §5 outputs: “mediaType: vc or vp” (§5); null on failure, by the last step group of §5.1 to §5.3.

allOf.$comment: §5.1, §5.2 and §5.3, when processing aborts: Set status to false, Set document to null, Set mediaType to null (no keyword).

on success each algorithm sets status to true, a mediaType and the document. “The verified document returned from verification MUST be a well-formed compact JSON-LD document, as described in Verifiable Credentials Data Model v2.0.” (w3c-vc-jose-cose#R-0080). The document is held to payload.derived, whose root imports @context and type from VC-DATA-MODEL-2.0 through this requirement. Whether it is well-formed compact JSON-LD needs JSON-LD processing and is not checked.

jose.$comment: §5.1: Set mediaType to vc or vp; Set document to the decoded JWS payload, a JWT Claims Set (payload.derived#jwt).

sdJwt.$comment: §5.2 as printed: Set mediaType to vc, and the document is the rebuilt JWT Claims Set. Only vc: §5.2's inputMediaType is vc+sd-jwt alone (I-09), although its heading names presentations and §3.2.2 defines vp+sd-jwt (README.md, Findings). A presentation verified by §5.2 has no conforming output; this anchor reports that, as the source does.

cose.$comment: §5.3: Set mediaType to vc or vp; Set document to the decoded COSE_Sign1 payload (decoded as JSON: inferred; every COSE example carries JSON text).
